{"id":1766566910,"question_id":72,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months, 1 week","timestamp":1757545724,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"47 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1766566910/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Edit Distance","memory":"10.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int dp[501][501];\n\n    int bymem(string &word1 , string &word2 , int i , int j)\n    {\n        //base case\n        //word1 is smaller and has finished \n        if(i >= word1.size())\n        {\n            return word2.size() - j;\n        }\n        //word2 is smaller and has finished\n        if(j >= word2.size())\n        {\n            return word1.size() - i;\n        }\n\n        if(dp[i][j] != -1) return dp[i][j];\n\n        //ek case hum solve karenge \n        int ans = 0;\n\n        if(word1[i] == word2[j])\n        {\n            //means matching characters appear ->then simply move ahead and check other characters\n            ans = 0 + bymem(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j+1); \n        }\n        else\n        {\n            //means the characters didnt match -> then do the operations needed\n            int insertion = 1 + bymem(word1 , word2 , i , j+1);\n            int deletion = 1 + bymem(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j);\n            int replacement = 1 + bymem(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j+1);\n\n            ans = min(insertion , min(deletion , replacement));\n        }\n        return dp[i][j] = ans;\n    }\n    int minDistance(string word1, string word2) {\n\n    memset(dp , -1 , sizeof(dp));\n\n    return bymem(word1 , word2 , 0 , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"edit-distance","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":777}
